subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <j.park@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Hi James / Asha —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through the demo. Really appreciate the thoughtful questions from the platform and security teams — good signal that there's a real production use case here. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the demo highlights and propose a short POC plan so we can align on success criteria and owners.

Quick recap from the demo:
- Redwood can run end-to-end inference for your transaction summarization and assistant flows with consistent p99 latency 
- Built-in KV prefix caching and batching should give ~2-3x cost improvement over naive hosting for your workload profile
- We showed embedding-based reranking and a sample prompt guard for PII filtering

Proposed POC objectives (summary):
1) Functional correctness: replicated example flows for transaction summarization and intent extraction (sample size: ~5k transactions)
2) Latency & cost: demonstrate p50/p95 latency under expected QPS and validate unit token cost estimates
3) Security & compliance gate: complete security questionnaire and confirm data handling (+KMS integration if required)

Proposed timeline & ownership (high-level):
- Kickoff: 2026-09-20 (Marissa)
- Data prep & ingestion: FinServCorp (Asha) + Redwood onboarding docs (Rishi) — 3 business days
- Run evaluation: 2 weeks of steady-state traffic (Redwood infra + FinServCorp tests)
- Wrap & exec summary: 3 business days after evaluation (Vivek)

Attachments: 20260912-redwood-demo-deck.pdf (demo deck), redwood-poc-plan.xlsx (detailed POC tasks & success criteria)

Next steps: Can you confirm the proposed kickoff date and the internal owners (Asha for technical lead, James as exec sponsor)? Also flag any mandatory procurement or legal steps we should loop in now.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: James Park <j.park@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@finservcorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finservcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary and the materials. The deck and POC plan look good at a high level. A couple of clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Success criteria: for acceptance we want to add precision/recall thresholds for the intent extraction (we can provide sample labels), and an SLA target for p95 latency under our test harness.
2) Security step: we need to run this through our security review (SOC2 checklist + a short architecture review). That will likely take 3–5 business days; can Redwood support a short pre-kickoff call with our security team to walk the architecture?
3) Data sensitivity: Asha will confirm whether we can provide anonymized transaction samples or need tokenization first.

If those items look OK to Redwood, the proposed kickoff on 2026-09-20 should work from my side. Confirm owners: Asha (technical lead), me (exec sponsor). I've CC'd procurement to flag any contracting steps.

Thanks,
James Park
Head of Platform Integrations
FinServCorp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@finservcorp.com>, James Park <j.park@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Thanks James — that all makes sense. Asha / James, below is an updated POC outline that includes the extra acceptance metrics and a security pre-kickoff. I attached a v2 of the PoC plan with task-level owners.

Updated POC outline (concise):
- Pre-kickoff (by 2026-09-19):
  - Security pre-call (Redwood infra + FinServCorp security) — target 45min (owner: Marissa + FinServCorp security)
  - Data sample: provide anonymized sample (owner: Asha)
  - Access: temporary API key + sandbox dataset created by Redwood (owner: Rishi)
- Execution (2026-09-20 -> 2026-10-05):
  - Ingest sample set (~5k records) and run baseline models (owner: Asha/Rishi)
  - Measure metrics: intent extraction precision/recall (target: precision >= 0.88, recall >= 0.80), p95 latency target <= 300ms for typical payloads (owner: Redwood + FinServCorp)
  - Cost validation: compare tokenized unit cost estimates vs baseline (owner: Vivek)
- Wrap & review (by 2026-10-08):
  - Exec summary and recommendation (owner: James + Marissa)

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v2.xlsx (detailed timeline, tasks, owners), 20260912-redwood-demo-deck.pdf

We're happy to run the security pre-call as early as this week (available slots: Wed 09/16 10:00-11:00 or Thu 09/17 14:00-15:00 PT). Which time works for you and your security lead?

Also, for procurement, we can start with a standard POC MSA and add the KMS clause as an addendum if required — Vivek is copied if procurement/legal needs a direct intro.

Best,
Marissa
